scope: Independent renderer-only screenshot/source review. Synthetic explicit reference fixture; not outer product UI, empirical sensor calibration, training efficacy or physical hardware acceptance.

refinements.issue: Modest contrast in low-quality styled-night reference scene.
refinements.disposition: Visible quad in supplied image; optional display/user evaluation. Do not force brightness or change sensor visibility.

refinements.issue: Front-on bird/fixed-wing contours can converge at distance or particular wing phase.
refinements.disposition: Expected illustrative ambiguity. More oblique/moving views can show differences; never promise always-correct recognition.
Optional artwork refinement; new scenery must not silently alter sensor occlusion or scoring.

resource_consistency.limitation: Previous-frame resource counts and callback intervals, not GPU timings, process memory or a long-run leak certification.

additional_capture.scope: Paused blurred scene. Selected-contact/paused UI proof only; cannot validate readable running production airframe.

limits: No browser driving, source edits or heavy tests for this review.
Static images cannot independently prove motion smoothness, pause/seek fidelity, gating, resource disposal or long-run performance.
Fixture is explicit reference truth with all contacts visible; not trainee sensing, measured detection/classification or sensor calibration.
Display zoom2/3 is a crop, not added sensor resolution.
Thermal and styled-night treatments are illustrative materials, not measured heat signatures.
200-contact overview is a reference stress scene, not200 individually identifiable operational contacts.
Preserved baseline uses different scenario/camera/zoom/sensor state; not a matched before/after experiment.
No whole-product acceptance, score or physical-platform pass.
